title: ehretia mollis
intro: Ehretia mollis, commonly known as the "Buddha's tree" or "Makandi", is a plant species native to tropical Asia and Australia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Ehretia mollis include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Ehretia mollis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
